selection_policy.raw_asset_priority: Prefer smaller qualified raw development models; small measured increases in packaged RLCZ size are accepted and recorded per actor and batch.
selection_policy.runtime_claims: Encoded input-key savings do not establish retained animation memory or frame-time savings because Godot rebakes curves at the declared cadence. Shared corrective GPU buffer savings are measured separately.
selection_policy.approximation: Exact batches retain their existing bounded float32/native/pixel gates. Approximate joint-curve trials are private and uninstalled.

independent_editor_verification.status: corrected for all changed creatures through batch36; later batches require explicit Editor proof at qualification
independent_editor_verification.claim_withdrawal: Previous imported-mode evidence could route through raw scene cache. Independent Editor claims require replacement with explicit imported PackedScene captures; source, fresh Blender, native, actual-Actor and effects proofs are unaffected.
